# @three-ws/see

> Let an AI agent SEE a 3D model: render any GLB from several angles and get back frames it can actually look at, plus the geometry facts.

@three-ws/see is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/see`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-see/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-see/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-see/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-see/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
